g.text: UML state machines - retained instruction state and financial finality
current member + unlocked vault + original native hold
all active members approve + payout owner rechecked
One family/date effect across all versions.
A run after review invalidates the revision.
A placed order is not a financial fill.
Only native cash/share evidence establishes FILLED.
A new request key cannot reuse a completed approval.
Changing input under an original key is refused.
original key / current ownership / atomic receipt
approved price bound + native cash/share effect + fill receipt
due UTC expiry releases original reservation
current UTC date; no paused-date catch-up
unique schedule/date run + native receipt + advance
safe failure code + bounded retry; no fabricated completion
fresh approved revision of unchanged reviewed basis
fresh approved revision; new version stays paused
original consent/runs retained; family continues in new version
